description: The plot titled “Whisper fine-tunning, type = small” shows word error rate (WER) across fine-tuning epochs for four small-model configurations (AdaLoRA int4, AdaLoRA int8, int4, and int8). The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 6 with integer tick marks at every 1 epoch. The y-axis is labeled “WER” on a linear scale, spanning roughly from 25 to a little above 42.5, with regularly spaced tick labels at about 2.5-unit intervals. The “small AdaLoRA_int4” series is an orange solid line with circular markers, decreasing overall from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to about 30.5 at epoch 6, with intermediate points near 34.7 (epoch 1), 33.8 (epoch 2), 32.9 (epoch 3), 32.1 (epoch 4), and 31.3 (epoch 5). The “small AdaLoRA_int8” series is an orange solid line with square markers, also trending downward from about 30.1 at epoch 0 to about 25.1 at epoch 6, passing through approximately 29.8 (epoch 1), 28.6 (epoch 2), 28.1 (epoch 3), 27.4 (epoch 4), and 26.6 (epoch 5). The “small int4” series is an orange dashed line with circular markers, rising from about 35.6 at epoch 0 to around 40.1 at epoch 1 and peaking near 42.2 at epoch 2, then declining to about 38.7 (epoch 3), 36.3 (epoch 4), 34.0 (epoch 5), and 31.6 (epoch 6). The “small int8” series is an orange dashed line with square markers, increasing from about 30.1 at epoch 0 to about 33.2 at epoch 1 and about 33.7 at epoch 2, then dropping to roughly 29.5 (epoch 3), 27.3 (epoch 4), 25.4 (epoch 5), and then moving slightly upward to about 26.0 at epoch 6.
